//! FOUR-valued residual semantics for the Codex Fibonacci.
//!
//! Belnap evidence states:
//!   N = neither support nor refutation
//!   T = support only
//!   F = refutation only
//!   B = both support and refutation
//!
//! Contradiction remains local and does not explode.

use std::fmt;

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Belnap FOUR
// ------------------------------------------------------------

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub enum V {
    N,
    T,
    F,
    B,
}

impl V {
    pub fn from_evidence(supports: bool, refutes: bool) -\succ V {
        match (supports, refutes) {
            (false, false) =\succ V::N,
            (true,  false) =\succ V::T,
            (false, true)  =\succ V::F,
            (true,  true)  =\succ V::B,
        }
    }

    fn bits(self) -\succ (bool, bool) {
        match self {
            V::N =\succ (false, false),
            V::T =\succ (true,  false),
            V::F =\succ (false, true),
            V::B =\succ (true,  true),
        }
    }

    /// Knowledge join: accumulate evidence.
    pub fn join(self, other: V) -\succ V {
        let (s1, r1) = self.bits();
        let (s2, r2) = other.bits();

        V::from_evidence(
            s1 || s2,
            r1 || r2,
        )
    }

    /// Knowledge meet: retain only shared evidence.
    pub fn meet(self, other: V) -\succ V {
        let (s1, r1) = self.bits();
        let (s2, r2) = other.bits();

        V::from_evidence(
            s1 && s2,
            r1 && r2,
        )
    }

    /// Belnap negation exchanges support and refutation.
    /// N and B are fixed.
    pub fn neg(self) -\succ V {
        let (s, r) = self.bits();
        V::from_evidence(r, s)
    }
}

// Special split–fuse structure

/// FSPLIT / δ
pub fn fsplit(v: V) -\succ (V, V) {
    (v, v)
}

/// FFUSE / μ
pub fn ffuse(a: V, b: V) -\succ V {
    a.join(b)
}

// Because join is idempotent:

//     μ(δ(v))
//   = μ(v,v)
//   = v ⊔ v
//   = v.
//

    pub leak_prob: Option\precf64\succ,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Thresholds {
    /// x \prec= eps supports the proposition "channel is clean".
    pub eps: f64,

    /// x \succ= reject supports its refutation.
    pub reject: f64,
}

/// Classify one scalar measurement.
///
/// A middle-band value is N, not B:
/// it supplies neither decisive support nor decisive refutation.
///
/// B requires independently accumulated conflicting evidence.
fn classify_scalar(x: Option\precf64\succ, t: Thresholds) -\succ V {
    match x {
        None =\succ V::N,

        Some(x) =\succ V::from_evidence(
            x \prec= t.eps,
            x \succ= t.reject,
        ),
    }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Semantic residual
// ------------------------------------------------------------

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub struct CnotResidual {
    /// Proposition:
    /// "the computational channel realizes the target gate."
    pub comp: V,

    /// Proposition:
    /// "the leakage channel is clean."
    pub leak: V,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub enum Tier {
    /// comp=T, leak=T
    Terminal,

    /// comp=T, leak=N
    UnresolvedLeak,

    /// comp=T, leak=B
    Crowley,

    /// comp=T, leak=F
    Contaminated,

    /// comp=B
    InconsistentGate,

    /// comp=F
    Failed,

    /// comp=N
    Unmeasured,
}

impl CnotResidual {
    pub fn tier(self) -\succ Tier {
        match (self.comp, self.leak) {
            (V::T, V::T) =\succ Tier::Terminal,
            (V::T, V::N) =\succ Tier::UnresolvedLeak,
            (V::T, V::B) =\succ Tier::Crowley,
            (V::T, V::F) =\succ Tier::Contaminated,

            (V::B, _) =\succ Tier::InconsistentGate,
            (V::F, _) =\succ Tier::Failed,
            (V::N, _) =\succ Tier::Unmeasured,
        }
    }

    /// Sequential composition accumulates evidence.
    pub fn compose(self, other: CnotResidual) -\succ CnotResidual {
        CnotResidual {
            comp: self.comp.join(other.comp),
            leak: self.leak.join(other.leak),
        }
    }

    /// FFUSE two independently obtained residual arms.
    pub fn fuse(a: CnotResidual, b: CnotResidual) -\succ CnotResidual {
        a.compose(b)
    }

    /// FSPLIT.
    pub fn split(self) -\succ (CnotResidual, CnotResidual) {
        (self, self)
    }

    pub fn special_closed(self) -\succ bool {
        let (a, b) = self.split();
        CnotResidual::fuse(a, b) == self
    }
